meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

howto.what: 进入该模式后,Claude 先宣告 'ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!',再按流程做编程任务:登记目标与成功标准、维护记事本与待办;先写失败测试再实现;最后用真实命令行或浏览器运行验证并存证,不空口说完成。
howto.when: 当你请求进入 ultrawork 模式,例如说 'ultrawork mode'、'ULTRAWORK'、'进入 ultrawork 模式' 等,且本对话还没启用过该模式时触发。

say.text: 以 ultrawork 模式开工:先登记目标,再修首页登录接口的 bug。
say.note: 它会先立下成功标准,再做失败测试和修复。

say.text: 进入 ultrawork 模式,新增订单查询功能,并在真实页面实测。
say.note: 会先写失败测试,再实现并留存可核对的运行证据。

say.text: 按 ultrawork 模式,把我的编码偏好存进长期记忆,之后沿用。
say.note: 长期事实会被保存,后续任务里会主动参考。

howto.what_en: Claude announces the mode, then follows a strict protocol: register a goal with success criteria, keep notepad+todos, write a failing test first, and verify on a real surface (CLI/browser/desktop) with captured evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to switch to ultrawork mode (e.g. 'ultrawork mode', 'ULTRAWORK') and that directive is not already in this conversation.

say_en.text: Start ultrawork mode: set the goal first, then fix the homepage login bug.
say_en.note: It sets success criteria first, then runs a failing test and the fix.

say_en.text: Enter ultrawork mode: add the order-status query and prove it for real.
say_en.note: It runs the real surface and captures evidence.

say_en.text: Ultrawork mode: keep my coding preferences in long-term memory.
say_en.note: Stores durable facts and consults them in later turns.
